programme.title: Athletics: Diamond League in Chorzów – day 2
programme.desc: The memorial, included in the Diamond League series, will once again attract the stars of the queen of sports and crowds of fans to Silesia. The attendance record of the previous edition - which was watched from the stands by nearly 43,000 people - was accompanied by the world records broken by Armand Duplantis in the pole vault and Jakob Ingebrigtsen in the 3000 m run. In addition to the competitions with their participation in Chorzów, interesting events promise to include, among others: short distance races. Ewa Swoboda will challenge Olympic champion Julien Alfred, and Natalia Bukowiecka's form in the 400 m race will be tested by Femke Bol. In total, up to 30 Polish representatives can appear at the Silesian Stadium. For some of them, this will be an important test before the World Championships in Tokyo

programme.title: Piotr Małachowski. The diamond man
programme.desc: Piotr Małachowski was not a good boy. Sometimes his life hung in the balance. He was born in the small town of Bieżuń in Masovia. He lost his father quickly, and his mother could barely make ends meet. His surroundings did not have a good influence on him. Despite his curved spine, he started practicing sports. He commuted to Ciechanów for training. There he met his friend Tomasz Majewski. The young players had no money, so they were hired to do various jobs. Only his first sports successes and his move to Warsaw changed the quality of Małachowski's life. In 2008 in Beijing, he won a silver medal in his Olympic debut. Since then, the discus thrower has won seven more medals in major events - he became the world and European champion, and in Rio de Janeiro in 2016, he added his second Olympic silver. He won the Diamond League four times. Sports success changed Piotr's life, but he did not forget about others. He regularly helps those in need, often anonymously... Poland. 2020. documentary film

programme.title: Dart: World Championships – London 2026 – final match
programme.desc: Luke Littler defends the championship title. The Englishman lost only two games on his way to the top four. In the semi-final he faced his compatriot Ryan Searle. In the second match, the Dutchman Gian van Veen and the Scotsman Gary Anderson faced each other

programme.desc: Eight profiles of captains of clubs playing in the PKO Bank Polski Ekstraklasa. These are the top players on their teams. They are at different stages of their careers, have different personalities, life principles and stories, but they are united by their love for football and the desire to win. These are eight great leaders. Kamil Grosicki is an extremely colorful figure in Polish football. In pursuit of his football dreams, he visited Europe - from Szczecin through Warsaw, to Switzerland, France, Turkey, and finally to his dream Premier League. A journey through clubs filled with challenges, temptations and would-be transfers. It docked in Szczecin again. programme.title: I was a king – Kazimierz Kmiecik | S01E04
programme.desc: A series presenting the profiles of the best scorers in the history of the Premier League. This is a great opportunity to recall the successes of Włodzimierz Lubański, Grzegorz Lata, Kazimierz Kmiecik, Grzegorz Piechna and Tomasz Frankowski. We will get to know different football generations. In the 1960s, Włodzimierz Lubański (Górnik Zabrze) was the top scorer four times in a row. However, in the 1970s, Kazimierz Kmiecik (Wisła Kraków) and Grzegorz Lato (Stal Mielec) reigned supreme. In more modern times, Tomasz Frankowski won four titles in the colors of Wisła Kraków and Jagiellonia Białystok. There will also be the story of Grzegorz Piechna, the unexpected top scorer from Korona Kielce in 2006. Kazimierz Kmiecik is a legend of Wisła Kraków. He was associated with it both as a player and as a coach. To this day, he is the best scorer in the history of the White Star. He scored 153 goals in 304 matches played. Poland. 2022-2025. documentary series

programme.title: River Monsters 3 – Devourer | S03E02
programme.desc: Jeremy Wade travels the world and looks at the strangest, most terrifying fish that inhabit rivers. He talks to people who survived the encounter with water monsters. Jeremy Wade goes to New Zealand to meet a man-eater. He tries to find out whether this creature only appears in legends and how much truth there is in the stories about attacks on divers, kidnapping children and devouring sheep. USA. 2011. documentary series

programme.title: Australian gold diggers | S01E01
programme.desc: Taking place in the beautiful, yet harsh scenery of Western Australia, the series shows the struggles of daredevils exploring deposits of precious metal. We follow three teams of searchers as they brave heat, equipment failure, and exhausting pressure. Christine and Greg Clark - aka Gold Gypsies - put it all on one card. Driven by gold fever, they abandoned their careers and their home in Brisbane. Vern Strange and his friend Leon Marsh form the band Dirt Dogs. They have invested as much as one million dollars in equipment and are anxiously awaiting profits. Kellie Carter and Henri Chassaing chose a different strategy. The friends venture into the wild, hoping to find previously undiscovered deposits. The Clarks are trying to achieve their goal - to find 80 ounces, or over 2 kg, of gold this season. They seek their fortune in an abandoned mine on Jack's Hill. Vern and Leon want to take advantage of an expiring gold mining license. The problem is that the permit covers a remote location. So the partners set off on a crazy race against time through the Australian bush. Kellie and her companion search in the wild wilderness. The harsh nature and 40-degree heat take their toll on them. To achieve their goal of 50 ounces of gold, the friends risk their lives. Australia. 2016. documentary series

programme.title: Wild Namibia – Life on the edge | E01
programme.desc: Namibia is a country of endless deserts and unique landscapes, from the Namib and Kalahari deserts to the savannah in the northeast. Life in desert areas is not easy. There is mainly drought and heat. The creators want to take a closer look at the desert. Germany. 2023. documentary series

programme.title: Africa: hot life – Dry savanna | E01
programme.desc: Almost all wild inhabitants of hot regions of the world, such as Africa, are at risk of extinction due to climate change. The authors wonder whether and to what extent they will be able to adapt to new, difficult living conditions. Lions' prey tend to feed when the hunters are resting - the hottest time of the day. The increase in temperature affects the behavior of animals living in these hot areas. Great Britain. 2022. documentary series

programme.title: 30 for 30: The New York Sack Exchange
programme.desc: 30 for 30 (Sports). As part of its 30th anniversary celebration, ESPN looks back at notable sports happenings that occurred from 1979 to 2009 with this documentary series featuring 30 films from some of Hollywood's finest directors and producers. Peter Berg, Barry Levinson, John Singleton, Spike Jonze, Dan Klores, Barbara Kopple, Ron Shelton and Albert Maysles are among the filmmakers involved, and the stories told include the shocking trade of Wayne Gretzky in 1988, the Baltimore Colts' nighttime move in 1984, Reggie Miller's rivalry with the New York Knicks, the death of Len Bias in 1986, a profile of George Steinbrenner and his family business, and a look at Michael Jordan's attempt at a baseball career. A new series of 30 films premiered in October 2012 with «Broke,» about the challenges athletes face in managing their money

programme.title: Auto-SOS, the best. Porsche 356
programme.desc: Tim and Fuzz head to East London to restore a 1964 Porsche 356 that will be, without a doubt, the worst car they've ever come across. Despite the poor condition the Porsche 356 was in under layers of rust and rot, it remains a top-end sports car legend that Porsche launched into production overnight. The car is owned by 67-year-old former ambulance driver Trevor, who has owned it since the 1980s. It was the car of his dreams, and although Trevor struggled to pay the ever-increasing bills for repairs, the car still had to be parked for a long time in a damp garage. Trevor never gave up the idea of ​​taking it on the road one day, but he was recently diagnosed with advanced prostate cancer, which meant that his hopes of restoring the car were dashed, but his daughters wrote to Tim and Fuzz in the hope that they could help their father get behind the wheel of his beloved car for the last time. Dir.: Stephen Taylor Woodrow, Theo Williams. Led by: Tim Shaw, Fuzz Townshed. USA, UK, 2012, reality show

programme.title: d/f Nazca Lines: Buried Secrets. Update
programme.desc: The greatest secret of the Peruvian Atacama Desert is the geoglyphs on the Nazca Plateau, which are more than 1000 years old and are visible only from the air. With the help of the first 3D maps of these now iconic outlines, and after solving the mystery of the burial of a headless man, archaeologists and scientists have suggested that the geoglyphs were used by the Nazca Indians as unique open-air temples in which they worshiped their gods of fertility and water. The use of drones, which are much more advanced for such research compared to the robotic helicopters used a decade ago, allowed scientists to discover 50 new geoglyphs. Many of these newly discovered images come from the Paracas culture, which predates the Nazca era, and researchers now have a better understanding of the region's geoglyph-making tradition, which dates back much earlier than previously thought, before the birth of Christ. USA, 2018

programme.title: d/f The Lost Continent of the Pacific
programme.desc: Legends about lost civilizations have haunted the minds of people since time immemorial. During the era of great geographical discoveries, explorers were looking for a mysterious country, which they called “terra incognita” (unknown country) in the depths of the world's oceans. Today, the elders of the people living on Easter Island claim that their predecessors came to this land from a continent called Khiva, which they believe sank into the ocean after some kind of natural disaster. Today, new scientific evidence points to the existence of a group of islands in Polynesia that were the center of an ancient civilization. For almost 400 years, these islands were known as the Marquesas Archipelago, and the aborigines living in Polynesia simply call them the “Hiva Islands”. Could they be the remnants of the lost continent of Khiva? Using the latest archaeological and geological data, oral legends, and centuries-old navigational techniques, we uncover these mysteries in The Lost Continent of the Pacific: A World of Water and Exploration, a series that tells the story of human sacrifice and the ancient sailors who crossed the vast ocean centuries before Columbus reached the Americas. USA, 2011

programme.title: d/f The Riddle of Keros

Participants in the quest will not only discover important historical finds, but will also uncover fascinating mysteries that could change our understanding of ancient civilizations. USA, 2020

programme.title: LOST U-BOATS OF WWII EP02

programme.title: HISTORY'S GREATEST MYSTERIES S4 EP05

programme.title: HISTORY'S GREATEST ESCAPES WITH MORGAN FREEMAN S2 EP16

programme.title: ANCIENT ALIENS S16 EP239

programme.desc: Chương trình giải trí thể thao này mang đến những lực lượng đặc biệt tốt nhất từ ​​Iron Squad để thực hiện một thử thách mới - Dodgeball. 26 người chơi sẽ tham gia một cuộc thi khốc liệt, cho đến khi một đội mạnh nhất được trang bị sức bền thể thao mạnh mẽ và sức mạnh tinh thần được hình thành. Chứng kiến ​​cách họ cạnh tranh trước các vận động viên ngôi sao và huấn luyện viên Dodgeball huyền thoại!

programme.title: ĐẶC VỤ VÔ HÌNH 2 - THE GREY MEN 2
programme.desc: Ông trùm Hội Tam Hoàng Song tìm cách xóa sạch hình ảnh của mình và chiếm lấy ghế thị trưởng của Laika trong bối cảnh chế độ thay đổi. Anh ta phải đối mặt với sự thiếu hụt kinh phí mặc dù đã thông đồng với các quan chức, đồng thời được cánh tay phải và người thi hành án của mình phạm tội để tăng cường quỹ và quyền lực của anh ta.
